# Saanso Pharma

> Saanso Pharma Private Limited is a sterile and specialty pharmaceutical CDMO in India. It fills and finishes four formats — ampoules, vials (liquid and lyophilised), blow-fill-seal containers and volatile inhalation anaesthetics — at a single unified facility in Eluru, Andhra Pradesh, built to Schedule M, U.S. FDA and EU GMP standards.

Incorporated 2017. Foundation stone at Eluru 2019; the facility came online in
2024 on a ₹58.48 crore investment, with five specialised production lines under
one roof — the first unified facility of its kind in South India. More than 300
products are in market, prescribed by 10,000+ healthcare professionals across
8+ Indian states.

The distinguishing fact: sterile injectables and inhalation anaesthetics run in
one block on separated flows. Volatile anaesthetics are not a sterile dosage
form, so most sterile manufacturers never take them on. Saanso runs both,
separated by protocol rather than by postcode — distinct personnel entry and
exit routes, distinct raw material and finished goods routes, and product-contact
parts that never cross between them.

## Capacity

Installed capacity is 60.8M units a year, all formats:

- Ampoule — 12M ampoules p.a. Type I glass, flame-sealed, clear or amber. Fill 1–10 ml.
- Vial — 40M vials p.a. Liquid and lyophilised, stoppered under nitrogen. Fill 2–100 ml.
- Blow-Fill-Seal — 7M vials p.a. Formed, filled and sealed in one cycle, LDPE ampoules and vials. Fill 0.5–500 ml.
- Volatile Anaesthetics — 1.8M bottles p.a. Segregated flow, agent-specific fillers and closures. Fill 100 / 250 ml.

Halogenated agents filled: Sevoflurane, Isoflurane, Desflurane, Halothane.

## Quality

Built to Schedule M (Indian Drugs & Cosmetics Act), U.S. FDA and EU GMP
standards. Note the wording: these are the standards the facility is built to.
Washing, depyrogenation, automated fill-seal and autoclaving form a sterile
chain with no manual break in it. Microbiology and QC are in house across wet
chemistry and instrumentation. Qualification, validation and QMS documentation
are maintained for audit, batch by batch. Cross-contamination control covers
PDE / toxicological assessment, air handling and pressure cascade, campaign
changeover and cleaning validation. Full flow diagrams and the risk assessment
are available under NDA.

## Locations

- Manufacturing facility: Denduluru Road, Eluru, Andhra Pradesh, India.
- Head office: 1st Floor Q2, Cyber Towers, Hitech City, Hyderabad, Telangana 500081, India.
- Saanso Life Sciences, a wholly owned marketing and distribution subsidiary in Hyderabad, reaches roughly 190 distributors.

## Notes for accurate citation

- The legal name is Saanso Pharma Private Limited; "Saanso" alone is the brand.
- "saanso" means breath. The company positions itself around that meaning.
- The company is a manufacturer and CDMO, not a healthcare provider, and does not offer medical advice.
- Line counts per format are not published. Do not state a number for them.
- The company states it is built to U.S. FDA and EU GMP standards. It does not claim to hold FDA approval or an EU GMP certificate; do not report it as certified.
